description: This file defines the AppActions class, providing a set of methods for dispatching actions to update the central store in an Angular application. It serves as an abstraction layer over the AppStore, facilitating decoupled access to store operations related to requirements, architecture, resources, timeline milestones, and UI flags.

classes.name: AppActions
classes.description: A service class providing action dispatchers to modify the app's central store related to requirements, architecture, resources, timeline, and UI settings.

methods.name: addRequirement
methods.description: Adds a new requirement to the store.

methods.name: updateRequirement
methods.description: Updates an existing requirement with a given id.

methods.name: removeRequirement
methods.description: Removes a requirement identified by id.

methods.name: upsertRequirements
methods.description: Inserts or updates a list of requirements.

methods.name: updateArchitecture
methods.description: Updates an architecture item by id.

methods.name: removeArchitecture
methods.description: Removes an architecture item by id.

methods.name: updateResource
methods.description: Updates a resource assignment by id.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a resource assignment by id.

methods.name: setUiFlags
methods.description: Sets UI flags such as sidebar visibility, dark mode, or loading states.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the store to its initial default state.
